However, it seems that at least sometimes those cases involve real memories with subsequent forgetting. We can illustrate these two types: in 40% of Chinese-American reincarnation studies, the children stated specific information about their previous life who was only known by others ("the recognizer effect"), yet the mother failed to confirm it due to a lack of knowledge; thus parents also do not invent all facts related to that phenomenon. In most cases, if an attempt at verification can be done (an extremely difficult and rare task), children claim some precise or even trivial data about themselves that cannot be known by others -the rememberer effect-although no statistical analysis has been performed on those studies; thus it is hard to assess their reliability and replicability. These researchers admit, however, that all other hypotheses except reincarnation seem very unlikely: such young "reencarnators" know details related to the past life, including many facts which cannot be learned elsewhere (in books or movies) 47 -but those findings were derived in Chinese studies only where we can expect less reliability. In English-language publications reporting similar results, data are rather mixed; for example, according to Stevenson and his colleagues' research that include American subjects: "a reincarnator knows the date of birth or death of the deceased person and recognizes it when shown a diary or newspaper clipping containing these dates". It was stated only about 30% of children studied -but in most studies no statistics were presented.29 Although scientists have often dismissed those cases as "fantasy", some researchers have taken them seriously. A better way would be (since Tokyo Cabinet is thread safe) having a separate thread/process which receives messages (using a message queuing system) that update the database files (ala MySQL replications). (Or you can separate out the db layer as a separate network service and partition the writes/reads to different servers if needed) ~~~ gcv The issue with Berkeley DB on NFS is not one of performance, but reliability. My husband was the project leader in designing a pipeline, and I saw how numerical methods played such an important role. The Seattle Seahawks have released star cornerback Richard Sherman, completing a dramatic overhaul of one of the more successful defenses in receThe Seattle Seahawks have released star cornerback Richard Sherman, completing a dramatic overhaul of one of the more successful defenses in recent history. The move underscores the franchise’s pivot toward rebuilding, as the team addresses a bloated salary cap and a roster that once dominated the league now faces a reckoning. Sherman, a three-time Pro Bowler and cornerstone of Seattle’s feared defensive unit, was set to earn over $13 million in base salary this season. General Manager John Schneider confirmed the decision was driven by financial constraints, stating, “We respect Richard’s legacy, but we’re in a position where we need to reset.” The Seahawks had explored restructuring his contract, but Sherman, who publicly expressed frustration over Seattle’s recent playoff struggles, declined. The release marks the latest in a series of high-profile departures, including the trade of safety Earl Thomas and the impending free agency of linebacker K.J. Wright.
